name: SGP112848 (Hubble)
blurb: SGP112848, an isolated elliptical galaxy in a cosmic void, seen by Hubble.
label: sgp112848-hubble
story: Far from the crowded clusters where most ellipticals live, this galaxy sits alone in a void. Hubble looked for fine structure in it, clues that its merger history may differ from that of cluster galaxies.

claims.text: SGP112848 is a target of the program on the fine structure of elliptical galaxies in voids
The sample is truly isolated ellipticals identified in the 2dFGRS
Void galaxies may have different merger histories, so their fine structure may differ; most knowledge of ellipticals comes from dense regions like clusters
